learnings.question: Which economist first argued, in a 1971 essay, that an abundance of information creates a scarcity of attention?
learnings.learning: Economist Herbert Simon wrote in 1971 that in an information-rich world, the wealth of information creates a scarcity of attention — the very thing information consumes.
learnings.articleTitle: Everybody wants your attention, but not everything deserves it.

learnings.question: According to Hadith 12 of the collection known as the 40 Hadith an-Nawawi, what is described as part of the perfection of a person's Islam?
options: Leaving alone that which does not concern him
Praying five times a day without fail
learnings.learning: Hadith 12 of the 40 Hadith an-Nawawi teaches that part of the perfection of one's Islam is leaving alone that which does not concern him.
learnings.articleTitle: Everybody wants your attention, but not everything deserves it.

learnings.question: Which 19th-century psychologist demonstrated that people forget roughly 80% of newly learned information within 24 hours unless they actively recall it?
learnings.learning: In the 1880s, Hermann Ebbinghaus showed that we forget about 80% of what we learn within 24 hours unless we actively force ourselves to recall it — the basis for spaced repetition.
learnings.articleTitle: Is Your Brain the Worst Place to Store Ideas? Why I Built a Second One

learnings.question: A well-known hadith (Sahih Muslim 1631) states that when a person dies, their good deeds stop except for three things. Which of these is one of them?
options: A large inheritance for the family
learnings.learning: Sahih Muslim 1631 states that when a person dies, all their deeds end except three: ongoing charity, beneficial knowledge, and a righteous child who prays for them.
learnings.articleTitle: Is Your Brain the Worst Place to Store Ideas? Why I Built a Second One

learnings.question: In the Scrum framework, which artifact visualizes a sprint's progress and shows how much work remains?
learnings.learning: In Scrum, the Burndown Chart visualizes the progress of a sprint, showing remaining work and whether the team is on schedule.

learnings.question: What is the main reason agile teams break their work into short, iterative cycles called Sprints?
options: To increase the length of the overall project
To eliminate the need for planning meetings
To allow for more flexibility and quicker adjustments
To reduce the number of team members needed
learnings.learning: Scrum breaks work into iterative cycles called Sprints specifically to allow for more flexibility and quicker adjustments as a project evolves.

learnings.question: According to Quran 51:56, for what singular purpose did Allah create jinn and mankind?
learnings.learning: Quran 51:56 states, 'I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me,' establishing worship as humanity's foundational purpose.

learnings.question: In Islamic theology, what Arabic term refers to humanity's role as caretakers or stewards of the earth?
learnings.learning: Quran 2:30 describes humans as khalifah — a successive authority or steward appointed upon the earth.

learnings.question: Which question did Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) reportedly ask himself to illustrate the importance of gratitude in worship?
options: 'Shall I not be a grateful servant?'
'Shall I not give to the poor?'
learnings.learning: Recorded in Sahih Bukhari 1130, the Prophet Muhammad asked, 'Shall I not be a grateful servant?' modeling gratitude as central to worship.

learnings.question: In PCIe power management, which state is described as a very light sleep that can quickly resume full activity, comparable to a computer screen turning off?
learnings.learning: The PCIe L0s state is a very light sleep designed for short idle periods, allowing the link to quickly wake and resume activity — similar to a screen turning off.
learnings.articleTitle: Power Management States in the context of PCIe

learnings.question: Which PCIe power state is nearly completely powered down, offering the greatest energy savings at the cost of the longest wake-up time?
learnings.learning: PCIe's L2 state is almost completely powered down, giving it the highest power savings of all states but also the longest time to wake back up.
learnings.articleTitle: Power Management States in the context of PCIe

learnings.question: In Islamic theology, what term refers to Allah's complete, eternal, and already-written plan for every event that will ever happen?
learnings.learning: Qadr refers to Allah's complete and eternal knowledge and plan of everything that will ever happen, distinct from Qada' — the actual unfolding of events.
learnings.articleTitle: The Art of Qada’ and Qadr

learnings.question: Which Quranic verse is commonly cited to show that people must change their own condition before their circumstances change?
options: 'Allah does not change the condition of a people until they change what is in themselves' (Surah Ar-Ra'd 13:11)
'And We have certainly honored the children of Adam' (Surah Al-Isra 17:70)
'Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth' (Surah An-Nur 24:35)
learnings.learning: Surah Ar-Ra'd (13:11) teaches that Allah does not change the condition of a people until they change what is in themselves, linking personal change to changed circumstances.
learnings.articleTitle: The Art of Qada’ and Qadr

learnings.question: When the Pareto Principle (80/20 rule) was tested on word frequency in the Quran, what percentage of the text did the top 20 most frequent words actually account for?
learnings.learning: A word-frequency analysis of the Quran found that, contrary to the 80/20 Pareto Principle, the top 20 most frequent words accounted for only about 20.83% of the text.
learnings.articleTitle: Top 20 Words to Understand the Quran: A Data Analysis using Python

learnings.question: In Arabic script, what are the small markings called that indicate which vowel sound to pronounce with each letter?
learnings.learning: Tashkeel are small diacritical marks placed above or below Arabic letters to indicate their vowel sounds, similar to how vowels function in English.
learnings.articleTitle: Top 20 Words to Understand the Quran: A Data Analysis using Python
